title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-21
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Pro fessional v10.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Charlie Miller soundboard captures a high‑energy 1982 Greek Theater show with a smoking Playin’ > UJB second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its pristine, CM‑engineered sound with only a minor flutter on Sugar Magnolia. Musically the concert shines especially in the second set where the Playin’ > Uncle John’s Band sequence is described as “apocalyptic” and the band is noted to be fully “on”. Overall the performance is energetic, tight, and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (10/12) give 4‑5 stars and extol both the sound quality and the musical performance, with consistent praise for the second‑set jams and Charlie Miller’s mastering.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear CM sound; minor flutter on Sugar Magnolia but otherwise crisp, balanced, and free of serious flaws.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > Uncle John's Band (second set)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is the highlight, with seamless transitions and focused jams; first set solid but less emphasized.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is called perfect; even a lyrical slip on Black Peter didn’t diminish his impact.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm work shines in the pre‑drums jam and his interplay with Brent is noted as ‘pretty great’.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s early‑era keyboards are praised, especially his jam into drums during the second set.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drumming section before the jams is described as some of the best playing ever heard.
